description: Occupational wages for a US metropolitan area or state nonmetropolitan area, from the Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS): mean hourly wage, mean annual wage and employment, for all occupations or one SOC occupation. Give the area by name ("Minneapolis-St. Paul", "Alexandria, LA"), by a member county ("Douglas County, MN"), or by 7-digit OEWS area code. Resolves the name against the publisher's own area list and returns candidates, never a guess, when the name is ambiguous or not an OEWS area (cities and micropolitan areas are not areas of their own). States the reference period actually returned and the series ids used. Answers "average wage in <metro>", "mean hourly wage in <area>", "what do software developers earn in <metro>".

area.description: Metropolitan or nonmetropolitan area name, a member county ("Douglas County, MN"), or a 7-digit OEWS area code ("0033460"). A trailing state ("Alexandria, LA" or "Alexandria LA") narrows the match.

soc_code.description: SOC occupation code, e.g. "15-1252" (software developers). Default "00-0000" (all occupations).

state.description: US state, 2-letter code or full name. Optional narrowing when the area name alone is ambiguous.

name: bls_area_wages

reference_period.description: May of the latest year the API returned

status.description: ok, ambiguous, not_found, no_data, or a BLS request status

title: Bls Area Wages
